name: SimReady demo bench
description: The empty bench with three NVIDIA SimReady food items imported by simready_import (nvidia/simready-assets@a666cb43, CC-BY-4.0): a cucumber, a cupcake and a green soda bottle. Each passed a 2 s drop test when placed.

agent.context: Three food items stand on the bench in front of the rail: a cucumber (52 x 170 x 48 mm, lying along x), a cupcake (75 mm across, at the standard gripper's 75 mm limit) and a green soda bottle (64 mm across, 231 mm tall). The bottle is too tall to grasp from above with this gripper; push it instead. The cucumber is the easiest to pick: grasp it at its centre from above.
task_ideas: pick up the cucumber and put it down 150 mm to the right
push the bottle 100 mm toward the back of the bench
lift the cucumber 100 mm and hold it there
move the cupcake 80 mm to the left
